title: Practice 2: об-: around — из-: all over

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Для вашего спокойствия я готов все магазины ___ (обегать / обегать — to run).
exercises.why: **обегать** — infinitive, imperfective (perfective partner: обегать).  Prefix **о-, об-, обо-**: movement around an object or involving a consecutive number of objects, circling, covering a whole place (вокруг + gen.; without preposition + acc).

exercises.q: Эти бестии ___ (обходить / обойти — to go around, to bypass) со стороны рынка.
exercises.why: **обходят** — present tense (3rd person plural) of обходить: imperfective (perfective partner: обойти).  Prefix **о-, об-, обо-**: movement around an object or involving a consecutive number of objects, circling, covering a whole place (вокруг + gen.; without preposition + acc).

exercises.why: **исходит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of исходить: imperfective.  Prefix **из-, изо-, ис-**: movement involving the entire area concerned and carried out in all directions; only formed from multidirectional verb of motion (without preposition + acc).
